title: handle_mailbox_query in-process filter duplicates MailboxFilterCondition field list
description: handle_mailbox_query manually extracts filter_parent_id, filter_name, filter_role, filter_has_any_role, filter_is_subscribed from raw args. MailboxFilterCondition defines the same five fields. These two definitions can diverge. Suggest: parse the filter arg into MailboxFilterCondition and use its fields directly in the in-process filter, removing the manual extraction.
